header: What the changeover form will ask you
subheader: Four steps, about 45 minutes in total. You can stop at any point.
lead: Before you start, have the article export from your old till and your printers' type plates ready. Together they cover half the form.
note: The form is on the next page. Once you send it, we reply within one working day with a changeover date.

steps.title: Business and branches
steps.text: Registered name, VAT number and each branch with its address and opening hours. We check the VAT number as you type.

steps.title: Articles and prices
steps.text: Fastest with an export from your old till. Otherwise, enter your 30 best sellers now and the rest later.

steps.title: Hardware
steps.text: Your printers, scales and card terminal. A model number or a photo of the type plate is enough.

steps.title: Check and send
steps.text: Review everything on one page. Nothing is sent until you press the button there.
